statement: Full compatible transverse connections still form an omega-squared torsor; over a smooth complex curve their marked P1 description is precisely a PGL2-oper/projective connection.
fate: B-Q01/08; BD§2.7 gives the marked P1 description and§3.1–3.3 the quadratic-differential torsor and canonical Borel object. Deligne I Proposition5.8 is a direct classical predecessor. No general arithmetic or Gauss–Manin conclusion follows.
